item.title: Former NASCAR driver's Lake Norman property hits the market at $6.5 million
item.description: TROUTMAN, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- Former NASCAR driver Regan Smith has listed his Lake Norman home for $6.5 million. According to Realtor.com, the nearly 11-acre property on Morrison Farm Road in Troutman boasts a 7,900-square-foot home.
